tokens.name: bg-primary
tokens.usage: Reading surface: header, content header, document pane, menus, palette, dialogs. Raised relative to bg-secondary.

tokens.name: bg-secondary
tokens.usage: App ground (body), tab bar, table header cells, inputs, sidebars.

tokens.name: bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Resting fill of toolbar buttons, inactive tabs, chips and inline code.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and controls on bg-primary, bg-secondary and bg-tertiary (light 14.2–17.4:1, dark 9.1–13.9:1). Dark is off-white on purpose to avoid halation.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, inactive tabs, blockquotes, h6 on bg-primary/secondary/tertiary (light 5.7–7.0:1, dark 7.1–10.8:1).

tokens.name: border-color
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header and bar dividers, control outlines, table rules, h1/h2 underlines. Decorative only — 1.4:1 light, 1.8:1 dark, below the 3:1 floor for a control boundary; controls also differ by fill.

tokens.name: accent-color
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: links, active tab rule, focus ring, hover/active fill of every toolbar button and menu item, selected palette row, blockquote rule. Link text 5.0–5.5:1 light, 6.8–8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover step of accent-color on filled buttons.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-color fills (light 5.5:1, dark 8.3:1). Flips to navy in dark because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: success-color
tokens.usage: Legacy source of color-success; same in both themes. 1.9:1 on bg-primary light — never use for text or as the only signal in light theme.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success toast edge, copied-state on the code copy button. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Info toast edge.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning toast edge, HTML-comment block rule. 2.2:1 on light grounds — decorative edge only; 8.1:1 on dark.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Error toast edge, destructive affordances. 3.8:1 on bg-primary light, 4.5:1 dark; 3.3:1 on toast-surface.

tokens.name: code-surface
tokens.usage: Fenced code block background in BOTH themes (matches the bundled github-dark highlight theme). Hard-coded in styles.css today.

tokens.name: code-border
tokens.usage: Code block and copy-button outline. Hard-coded today.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Un-highlighted code and copy-button text on code-surface (16:1). Hard-coded today.

tokens.name: toast-surface
tokens.usage: Toast chip in both themes; text is white (12.8:1). Hard-coded today.

tokens.name: search-highlight
tokens.usage: Search match mark. Light keeps text-primary (13.5:1); dark sets #1a1a1a text on it (5.35:1). Hard-coded today.

tokens.name: search-highlight-current
tokens.usage: Current search match with a #e65100 outline, #1a1a1a text (8.08:1) in both themes. The outline sets it apart from other matches. Hard-coded today.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Live-reload dot on the watch chip and tab. A dot beside the word Live, never alone. Hard-coded today.

tokens.name: status-changed
tokens.usage: Background-tab 'changed on disk' dot, pulsing. Hard-coded today.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Logo halo and wordmark gradient start. Brand only — not used in the UI today.

tokens.name: brand-coral
tokens.usage: Logo halo and wordmark gradient end. Brand only.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Logo core diamond, gradient start.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Logo core diamond, gradient end.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: The mark's eyes.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The mark's shield and the 'Spec' half of the wordmark (18:1 on white).

tokens.name: brand-tile
tokens.usage: App icon tile behind the mark.

tokens.name: starfield-ground
tokens.usage: Starfield theme (the default on every surface): empty-state sky behind the drop card. Nebulae of brand-teal, brand-coral and starfield-violet at 10–28% alpha float over it; the canvas draws stars and a cursor comet. #070b18 when no light/dark is set.

tokens.name: starfield-violet
tokens.usage: Starfield's third nebula, low alpha (10–22%). Decorative only.

tokens.name: aurora-ground
tokens.usage: Aurora theme empty-state ground; #06141c when unset. Curtains sweep over it (22s, CSS only).

tokens.name: aurora-green
tokens.usage: Aurora curtain, 18–32% alpha. Decorative only.

tokens.name: aurora-sky
tokens.usage: Aurora curtain, 14–28% alpha. Decorative only.

tokens.name: aurora-violet
tokens.usage: Aurora curtain, 10–24% alpha. Decorative only.

tokens.name: blueprint-ground
tokens.usage: Blueprint theme empty-state ground; #0b2a4a when unset.

tokens.name: blueprint-line
tokens.usage: Blueprint grid: 24px minor lines at 10–12% alpha, 120px major lines at 20–22%, plus an inset frame 12px from the edge.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: C+ brand moments, default on every surface. Fill for active toolbar toggles and the current Contents link; accent-color text on it measures 4.6:1 light, 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: brand-teal-text
tokens.usage: C+ brand moments, default on every surface. Teal marks and text: read ticks in Contents, diagram edges and borders (5.0:1 light, 5.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-coral-text
tokens.usage: C+ brand moments, default on every surface. Coral marks: diagram secondary borders (5.2:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-teal-tint
tokens.usage: C+ brand moments, default on every surface. SpecDown diagram style node fill (bundled samples only).

tokens.name: brand-coral-tint
tokens.usage: C+ brand moments, default on every surface. SpecDown diagram style secondary fill (bundled samples only).

tokens.name: read-aloud-sentence
tokens.usage: Read aloud: fill behind the sentence being spoken, with a 2px brand-teal-text underline (inset box-shadow). text-primary on it: 16.1:1 light, 10.9:1 dark. Teal means reading progress in C+; never use search-highlight (a match) or accent (act on this).

tokens.name: scope-mark
tokens.usage: Explain: marks the explained scope in the document while the rail is open, because the native selection is lost when focus moves to the rail.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: Markdown h1; 2px border-color underline, 0.3em padding below.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Open a Markdown file to read it with live diagrams.

styles.name: doc-code
styles.usage: Inline and block code. Source currently sets 'Courier New' for inline code instead of --font-mono — drift.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Toolbar buttons, search input, toasts, menu items.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Version label, search count, palette hints.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, palette rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Command palette, dialogs, iOS action buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and badges.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: App header.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Skip link, hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, command palette, dialogs.

tokens.name: rail-width
